preexisting_helper.finding: buffered_sse_projection waits silently for the durable transaction; it emits no bytes until completion

reproducer.condition: slow commit-critical task; first SSE byte awaited for less than task duration
reproducer.observed: no byte before timeout while the server-owned task remains alive
reproducer.risk: long Notion work can hit client/proxy idle timeout even though the durable transaction correctly continues

contract: while durable transaction is pending, emit only neutral SSE comments ': stageb-commit-pending'
neutral comments contain no response/item/call ids and no provider/tool payload
wait uses asyncio.shield so timeout/client cancellation never owns the server transaction
after durable completion, project exactly the canonical persisted response
transaction failure propagates without fabricating a protocol result
heartbeat interval is lower-bounded to avoid a busy loop

covered: slow transaction emits multiple neutral comments before exact canonical response
fast transaction does not force a heartbeat
client closes projection after heartbeat but server-owned task still commits
transaction exception after heartbeats propagates with no response protocol payload
non-positive configured interval is bounded and cannot busy-loop
